notes: ChaTOR hook offsets for swtor.exe, keyed by the SHA256 of the executable.
All values are RVAs relative to the swtor.exe image base, written as hex strings ("0x5220b0") or plain numbers.
The hosted offsets server returns a document in this exact format containing the latest builds; entries from the server take priority over the ones here.
Known offset names (unknown names are ignored by the DLL):
chat_recv       chat receive handler, hooked for logging. Also found at runtime via the "ReceiveChatMessage" string when dynamic lookup is enabled; this value is the fallback.
roll_handler    template substitution function used for /roll output
cmd_dispatch    chat command dispatch (send path). Also found at runtime via the dword 0x41d98bec inside it when dynamic lookup is enabled.
global_ptr      global holding the OmegaClientApp, start of the chain to cmd_dispatch's manager. With dynamic lookup the DLL finds it (and the two vtables) itself through RTTI class names.
context_vtable  vtable of the OmegaAreaObject at [global_ptr]+0x30 (sanity check)
manager_vtable  vtable of the AreaServerRequestIFaceProxy at context+0x48 (sanity check)
friends_list    friends list update handler (currently unused)
chat_channel_recv     ChatGatewayObject's channel-message handler, hooked to learn channel ids. Also found at runtime through RTTI (ChatGatewayResponseIFace vtable, entry 0).
chat_channel_message  chat gateway RPC: message to a channel (guild, general, ...). Also found at runtime by its RPC id 0x89193f50.
chat_whisper          chat gateway RPC: whisper. Also found at runtime by its RPC id 0x5a249b1a.

versions.notes: global_ptr / vtables found 2026-10-18 by following the live chain to the manager captured from a game call; RTTI names match.
